gap: No result ChatGPT got states today's maker-store prices for the 10,000 mAh phone power banks it recommended: Anker's own US store charges $59.99 for the Nano 10K 45W retractable (0.51 lb), while INIU sells its own 45 W built-in-cable 10K for $26.99 (Carry P55L-E2) or $22.99 (Pawsible Slim P41L-E2) and Belkin its 20 W built-in-cable 10K for $24.99, so the 'premium' Anker pick costs 2.2 to 2.6 times as much for the same capacity and wattage class.
standout_why: Compared against powerbank-online.com (rank 1: specs and ratings from Amazon, explicitly no prices and no tests), Engadget (Feb 2026: tests on larger banks, no price for most picks, none of ChatGPT's three models), Anker's own blog (no prices), and oscarmini.com (rank 9: 'about $25/$30/$60' estimates plus the recall list). None gives a maker-direct price with a date for the INIU, Anker or Belkin 10K built-in-cable banks, none lists Baseus PicoGo AM52 at all, and none notes that Anker's own store matches the $59.99 Walmart price while a refurbished A1638 page exists. The recall angle (Anker A1257 10K 22.5 W, 481,000 units, 33 fire reports) is already on oscarmini, so it only earns partial credit; our contribution there is flagging that ChatGPT's 'Everyday choice' card (Anker 10,000 mAh, 22.5 W, built-in cable, $25.88 Walmart) has the same capacity and wattage as the recalled A1257 and the shopper should check the model number before buying.
decides: Confirms ChatGPT's value pick but overturns the price ladder: the INIU Carry P55L-E2 (45 W, built-in cable) at $26.99 from INIU's store and the Pawsible Slim P41L-E2 at $22.99 deliver the same 10,000 mAh and 45 W as the $59.99 Anker Nano, so the Anker only wins if the shopper wants the retractable cable and is willing to carry the heaviest unit (0.51 lb vs INIU's 160 g Carry P50 at $32.99). The Baseus PicoGo AM52 with cable at $55.99 (down from $89.99) becomes the pick only for an iPhone owner who wants Qi2.2 25 W magnetic charging. The Walmart Anker 22.5 W pick should be dropped or model-checked against the A1257 recall.
